# port/input/pad-boot-mirror.txt: pad-boot.txt with Mirror mode On picked at
# New Game (renderer wave 7, R7c).
#
# Derived from port/input/pad-boot.txt; its notes on the format and on each
# boot screen apply here. Since R7c the vibration screen (layout 9,
# la_vibe_select) is followed by the port's New Game screen: "Off" and
# "On" side by side, the cursor on "Off"; RIGHT moves to "On", CROSS or START
# confirms and starts the game (gflag 382, which the vibration screen set
# before R7c). pad-boot.txt's cycle answers it unchanged: its next CROSS or
# START picks Off. This script differs from it in one line: the LEFT at
# tick 608 is a RIGHT, so the CROSS at 621 picks On.
#
# Timing (measured, build-host/r7c-run-headless with the R7c build, and
# 6c-run-headless before it): the CROSS at 581 confirms the vibration screen
# (before R7c gflag 382 set there). The switch to the New Game screen is the
# vibration screen's fade out (texLayout[9].fadeOutTime 0.2 s = 5 ticks),
# then the New Game screen's fade in (0.3 s = 7 ticks): it takes input from
# about tick 595. The START at 594 lands during the fade and is ignored; the
# RIGHT at 608 moves the cursor; the CROSS at 621 confirms On. The game
# starts at 621, 40 ticks later than before R7c, and every later line meets
# the game 40 ticks later than it did then (as with pad-boot.txt now).
